hard_gates.evidence: Both Jina adapters require their registered current v5/v3 identities before provider I/O; three drift probes passed.

hard_gates.name: historical-result-integrity

hard_gates.name: deployment-and-recovery-regression
hard_gates.evidence: The candidate passed 31 deployment tests, 41 in-process checks, 15 live checks, and three five-check recovery replays.

hard_gates.name: zero-model-call-synthetic-boundary
hard_gates.evidence: All policy and deployment checks used synthetic data and made zero model calls.

decision.rationale: The candidate preserves the no-Gemma boundary and qualified staging workflow while preventing silent hosted retrieval-model drift.
limitations: Jina model identity and transport enforcement are verified, but retrieval quality is not evaluated or selected.
Qwen3.5 installation and identity remain unselected for any product role.
The deployment run used synthetic data, localhost, and one development host.
Public DNS, trusted certificate issuance, target-host restore, professor-fidelity calibration, multimodal quality, factual-QA scale quality, and human usability remain pending.
